label: notional
notes: Read from the page markdown on 2026-10-28; the page shows no last-updated date. Prices are USD per million tokens (MTok).
Model ids are the page display names mapped to the ids seen in transcripts (01-RESEARCH.md, Model-id mapping); a trailing -YYYYMMDD is stripped before lookup.
Cache read (hit) | 0.1x base input price (0.025x on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1; 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5)

Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays higher prices. A request's prompt length counts all of its input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes. Each request is priced on its own.

For Claude 4.6 and later models, specifying US-only inference through the inference_geo parameter incurs a 1.1x multiplier on all token pricing categories, including input tokens, output tokens, cache writes, and cache reads. Earlier models do not support the inference_geo parameter.

Fast mode (Claude Opus 5.5 $8 input / $40 output; Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 $10 input / $50 output per MTok): prompt caching multipliers and data residency multipliers apply on top of fast mode pricing. The fast rows here apply those multipliers; they are cited and unobserved in the data.
The Batch API discount, the tool-use and web-search charges, and Claude Managed Agents pricing are not modeled; web search is priced per 1,000 searches and is not a token charge.
Left out on purpose: Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Mythos 5 and Claude Haiku 3.5 (no transcript model id seen for them, so their ids are not guessed). No claude-fable-5-0 row exists on the page.
